visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Child is centred only one way
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The box is meant to sit in the middle of the card, but it is stuck at the top, centred only from left to right. One property is missing.

solution.explanation: justify-content works along the main axis (the row) and align-items across it. Both are needed to centre in two directions. Without align-items the item stretches or sits at the start of the cross axis.

checks.label: The box is centred sideways
checks.expr: (() => { var s = el('.card').getBoundingClientRect(), d = el('.box').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs((s.left + s.width / 2) - (d.left + d.width / 2)) < 1; })()

checks.label: The box is centred up and down
checks.expr: (() => { var s = el('.card').getBoundingClientRect(), d = el('.box').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs((s.top + s.height / 2) - (d.top + d.height / 2)) < 1; })()
